glioma_tumor.name: Glioma Tumor
glioma_tumor.symptoms: Seizures, headaches, memory loss, personality changes, speech difficulties, vision problems
glioma_tumor.treatment: Surgery, Radiation Therapy, Chemotherapy, Targeted Therapy
glioma_tumor.description: Gliomas are tumors that develop from glial cells in the brain and spinal cord. They can be aggressive and require immediate treatment.

meningioma_tumor.name: Meningioma Tumor
meningioma_tumor.symptoms: Vision problems, nausea, behavioral changes, headaches, hearing loss, seizures
meningioma_tumor.description: Meningiomas are usually benign tumors that develop from the meninges, the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord.

pituitary_tumor.name: Pituitary Tumor
pituitary_tumor.symptoms: Hormonal imbalances, vision problems, headaches, fatigue, weight changes
pituitary_tumor.description: Pituitary tumors affect the pituitary gland and can cause various hormonal problems. Most are benign and treatable.

no_tumor.name: No Tumor Detected
no_tumor.description: No brain tumor was detected in the MRI scan. The brain appears normal.
